items.title: Future partner needs, Jobs and outcomes
items.definition: Partner-facing UI and organization records exist, but no separate partner discovery research establishes partner needs, Jobs or outcomes.
items.resolution_gate: Separate partner research and explicit owner decision; route or UI existence is insufficient.
items.prohibited_shortcut: Infer partner Jobs from `/partners/`, `/partnerstvo/`, organization pages or commercial assumptions.

items.title: Product-wide task completion and outcome evidence
items.definition: Search health proves one bounded live journey, while product-wide discovery, decision confidence, saved-state recovery and personalization outcomes lack one accepted production-wide readout.
items.resolution_gate: Versioned production event/metric contracts, complete denominators, coverage report and reviewed analysis record.
items.prohibited_shortcut: Treat UI existence, deployment, click-through or one healthy synthetic journey as a proven outcome.

items.title: Public static root remains NO-GO
items.definition: Immutable candidates and default-off atomic publisher exist, but URL lifecycle, critical data progression, live ALB/SWS/DNS, rollback and full acceptance gates remain open.
items.resolution_gate: All P0 release gates and accepted root evidence on an exact main-reachable SHA.
items.prohibited_shortcut: Call a secret candidate or checked artifact a production root release.

items.title: Critical producer progression and downstream consumption
items.definition: Required producers do not yet have the complete scheduled terminal evidence, no-change receipts, downstream-consumption proof and failure drills required by the release plan.
items.resolution_gate: Versioned producer registry, production schedule, three consecutive terminal passes and both required failure drills.
items.prohibited_shortcut: Treat an old last-good artifact or a job start as evidence that the pipeline progressed.

items.title: Personalization value and diversity uplift
items.definition: Target architecture, signal policy, fallback and acceptance exist, but no accepted randomized holdout proves causal improvement while preserving diversity and guardrails.
items.resolution_gate: Registered holdout/A-B contract, compatible model/profile revisions, coverage and owner-reviewed outcome evidence.
items.prohibited_shortcut: Compare self-selected `/dlya-menya/` visitors with the general audience or feed action-map diagnostics directly into the profile.

items.title: Favorites local/account/multi-device reconciliation
items.definition: Saved-state semantics are defined, but anonymous-to-account merge, account switching, cross-tab synchronization and multi-device revision lag lack complete accepted runtime evidence.
items.resolution_gate: Correlated E2E receipts across local, account, account-switch and multi-device contexts with zero duplicate/leak evidence.
items.prohibited_shortcut: Infer durable recovery from a local UI state or one browser session.

items.title: Event detail unresolved semantic states and decision outcome
items.definition: The corrected contract keeps evidence-bound states honest, including unresolved desktop and mobile media branches; behavioral proxies do not directly prove decision confidence.
items.resolution_gate: Exact source/browser evidence for unresolved states, owner review, native bindings and mixed behavioral/qualitative decision evidence.
items.prohibited_shortcut: Promote requested but unobserved states or equate engaged reading with confidence.

items.title: Corrected archetypes are reconstructed, not promoted UI families
items.definition: The corrected global archetype package provides stable semantic IDs and source evidence, but native component/archetype promotion and consumer migration remain separate gates.
items.resolution_gate: Astro == Git SoT == Penpot parity, owner acceptance, exact bindings, consumer migration and fail-closed conformance.
items.prohibited_shortcut: Call reconstructed semantic contracts promoted components or accepted visual design.

items.title: Product Atlas and UI native Penpot bindings
items.definition: No public reviewed Product Atlas MCP materialization receipt or stable native binding IDs exist for this Git-only version.
items.resolution_gate: After the parity entry gate, run an explicit scoped Penpot MCP task, read back exact file/page/object identities and commit a reviewed receipt.
items.prohibited_shortcut: Invent UUIDs, infer IDs from links, or treat local/unpublished bindings as public evidence.

items.title: Remove obsolete Product Atlas plugin path from active documentation and artifacts
items.definition: Historical plugin documentation, contract, prototype and stable-delivery references conflict with the accepted MCP-only operating path until removed or explicitly archived by Git history.
items.resolution_gate: Design-system child PR deletes plugin contract/prototype and replaces active docs with MCP-only delivery; product docs point to the new decision.
items.prohibited_shortcut: Leave plugin language in active planning while describing it as current architecture elsewhere.

items.title: Interest-club detail browser evidence failure
items.definition: The corrected route registry maps `/kluby-po-interesam/game-vibes/` but both browser observations failed, so route linkage is preserved without pretending runtime visual evidence passed.
items.resolution_gate: Reproduce the exact route at pinned source/snapshot and obtain successful desktop/mobile browser observations or a typed product/runtime disposition.
items.prohibited_shortcut: Treat 100% route-to-archetype mapping as 100% successful browser health.

items.title: No active first-party action-map campaign
items.definition: The action-map contract is accepted, but active capture is optional, default-off and not required to materialize Product Atlas Git SoT.
items.resolution_gate: Only a registered question and decision use may justify AM-1 through AM-4; otherwise the correct state remains off/not applicable.
items.prohibited_shortcut: Treat absence of an active campaign as a product failure, invent a measurement question or enable permanent clickstream collection.
